info.title: getvinyls API
info.description: Read-only public API for vinyl record discovery.

200.description: A paginated page of vinyls with their tracks, genres, and a cheapest-price summary. Vinyls listed by more shops come first (so records available in multiple shops lead), then newest first. The cursor is an offset into this ranking. Optionally filtered to vinyls carrying any of the genres in `genres` (comma-separated slugs).
A page of vinyls matching the query, in relevance order. Same shape as GET /vinyls; the cursor is an offset into the ranked results.

503.description: Search is unavailable (not configured, or the search server is unreachable).

200.description: The requested vinyl with its tracks, genres, and shop offers.
A list of shops.
The shop's identity and how many distinct vinyls it lists.
A cursor-paginated page of the vinyls this shop lists.
A list of genres.

post.summary: Add a vinyl or track to favorites

404.description: The target vinyl or track does not exist.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's favorited vinyls

200.description: The favorite was removed (idempotent: also 200 if it was not favorited).
